about: Feels Good is a simple black-and-white line drawing of a bald, broad-shouldered man with his eyes closed and both palms pressed to his cheeks, mouth open in a blissful exhale. His whole face says total relief and satisfaction, like he just splashed cold water on his face after a long day. It is the reaction for small, perfect moments of satisfaction: the last piece clicking into place, a task finally done, a clean refactor, a well-timed comeback. It is a separate meme from Pepe the Frog's "feels good man."
origin: The drawing was traced from a stock photo of a man washing his face, a picture often used in skin-care advertising. It caught on as a reaction image on 4chan.
usage:
The bottom box usually just says "feels good," while the top box describes the satisfying moment. You can also leave the top empty and post it as a reply.

Good picks are tiny, specific pleasures: cancelled plans you dreaded, a perfectly peeled sticker, all tests passing on the first run, a full night's sleep, a stoppage-time winner. The calmer and smaller the win, the funnier the over-the-top bliss on his face.
ideas: all tests pass on the first run
peeling the plastic off a new screen
stoppage time winner against your rival
